description: CLK1 (2m, the wanted signal is the fundamental) through a cheap 200 MHz low-pass, then a cheap band-pass marked 137M/140M, then a measured 37 dB pad set

chain.name: LC low-pass 200MHz
chain.notes: three series inductors and four capacitors to ground; connected directly to CLK1

chain.name: LC band-pass 137M/140M
chain.notes: L-C-L-C-L in series with capacitors to ground at each junction; connected after the low-pass

chain.name: pad set
chain.notes: measured, not the labels: the 27-33-27 ohm T pad (15 dB) in series with the BNC attenuator marked 10 dB (really 27 dB), joined with SMA/BNC adapters. Measured together without a filter on 2026-10-31 as 37.4 dB at 145 MHz (36.9 to 38.4 dB from 20 to 180 MHz).

notes: Compare with 2m-lc-bandpass-137-140MHz-37dB (band-pass only) and 2m-lpf-200MHz-37dB (low-pass only). Same pad set, so levels are comparable. The low-pass is first, next to the Si5351.
